prompt: Williamson ether synthesis: sodium phenoxide + 1-chloropropane. Draw the ether.
explanation: Phenoxide (ArO⁻) is a soft, stabilized nucleophile. It attacks a 1° alkyl halide via SN2 to give an aryl alkyl ether. Note: aryl halides don't do Williamson the other way (ArX + RO⁻ fails — SNAr needs strong EWGs on the ring).
